summary.decision_rationale: All 4 KPIs passed with 100% weighted score. Comprehensive intelligence map with 29 companies across all categories, 87% profile completeness, and 100% source attribution.

key_findings: Highly competitive direct space with 14 well-funded competitors (total funding >$850M)
Market timing is favorable - category validated but not saturated (2020-2023 surge)
Adjacent threat from sales enablement giants (Gong, Outreach, Salesloft) and CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce)
Differentiation opportunity: AI-led conversational demos (no direct competitor doing this)
Failed company lessons: avoid burning 17x revenue/month, focus on PMF before scale

competitive_position.differentiation: AI-led conversational demos (not screenshot-based, not video-based, not human-led)
competitive_position.market_gap: No competitor offers AI-led, conversational, real-time product demos at scale

risks.description: HubSpot Breeze AI and Salesforce Agentforce could add demo automation features
risks.mitigation: Integrate early, differentiate on quality, speed to market (12-18 month window)

risks.description: Poor AI demo quality could damage brand and customer trust
risks.mitigation: Invest heavily in AI quality, human review loops, customer feedback

risks.description: AI-led demos is new category requiring market education
risks.mitigation: Content marketing, case studies, pilot programs with early adopters

recommendations: Start with SMB PLG motion ($10-30K ACV) to prove PMF before scaling
Target 50-100 customers, $500K ARR in first 6 months
Monitor adjacent players (Salesloft+Drift, HubSpot AI, Salesforce Agentforce) closely
Maintain capital efficiency: keep burn <3x revenue (lesson from Fast failure)
